deviation: The final historical test was inspected repeatedly across phases.
effect: All final historical results are adaptive, not independent confirmation.
resolution: Preserve labels; require external/prospective confirmation for strong claims.

deviation: Validation-calibrated scores were historically used for some ROC/PR and grouped-ranking summaries.
effect: Tie-inducing isotonic calibration caused small ranking-metric discrepancies.
resolution: Raw scores are authoritative for ranking; calibrated scores for proper/decision metrics.

deviation: A purge of 10 global dates left 180 boundary-crossing labels.
effect: Threshold metrics were affected; pooled ranking changed little.
resolution: Retrained with measured purge 18 and one-date embargo.

deviation: Union-calendar placeholders contaminated eligibility and historical coverage.
resolution: Observed-session construction enforced; corrected Transformer is authoritative.

deviation: Protocol amendment 1 clarified zeroed no-ID channels, pair registry, per-asset price source and raw ranking scores.
effect: Made executable contract explicit without result-informed tuning.

deviation: Four validation assets lacked both-class pair support.
effect: Within-asset pair metric covers 75 validation assets rather than all 79.
resolution: Pair support reported; no synthetic pairs or eligibility relaxation.

deviation: The continuous outcome is maximum origin-to-path loss, not peak-to-trough drawdown.
effect: Economic interpretation is narrower than the word drawdown can imply.
resolution: Use exact maximum adverse total-return movement wording.

deviation: The ridge sequence-summary control uses registered summary/lag features rather than a fully flattened sequence.
No-ID fixed-width neural arms retain 12 immutable zero channels.
effect: Parameter shapes remain comparable; channels carry no identity information.

deviation: Initial rerun inherited Phase 1 groups instead of the fixed final feature groups.
effect: Group labels and allocations were inconsistent, but checkpoints and predictions were unchanged.
resolution: Explicit exhaustive 34-feature partition; checkpoint-only rerun; updated reports.

deviation: Seven FRED inputs are current-vintage/provenance-limited rather than fully ALFRED-vintage reconstructed.
effect: Positive macro attribution or causal claims are inadmissible.
resolution: Retain only as sensitivity; require point-in-time replication.

deviation: Simulation remains stylised despite independent extension with common shocks and dependence controls.
effect: Shows mechanism sufficiency, not empirical prevalence or causality.
resolution: Constrain claim language and seek external calibration.

deviation: The smoke manifest did not exercise every arm before full execution.
effect: Weakens process assurance but did not change the negative scientific verdict.
resolution: Post-execution artifact and summary audit completed.

deviation: Neighbouring origins have overlapping outcome windows.
effect: Naive row-wise uncertainty would be anti-conservative.
resolution: Use date-block inference and non-overlapping-origin sensitivity; do not treat rows as independent.
